<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="24" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">9:41</text>
    <line x1="322" y1="18" x2="326" y2="18" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="15" x2="330" y2="18" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="12" x2="334" y2="18" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="338" y1="9" x2="338" y2="18" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="15" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="349" y1="11" x2="357" y2="19" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="9" width="18" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="383" y="12" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#18191F"/>
    <rect x="367" y="11" width="13" height="7" rx="1" fill="#00C6AE"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <text x="32" y="66" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Tuesday, July 28</text>
    <text x="32" y="99" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="27" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Good morning, Alex</text>
    <circle cx="356" cy="83" r="22" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="356" y="90" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">A</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Search -->
  <g>
    <rect x="32" y="122" width="326" height="56" rx="16" fill="#F4F5F7" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="147" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="63" y1="153" x2="69" y2="159" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="82" y="153" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#969BAB">Search tasks and events</text>
    <line x1="328" y1="140" x2="328" y2="160" stroke="#9FA4B4" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="322" y1="145" x2="334" y2="145" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="322" y1="151" x2="334" y2="151" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="322" y1="157" x2="334" y2="157" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Section heading -->
  <g>
    <text x="32" y="207" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Upcoming</text>
    <text x="305" y="207" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1947E5">See all</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Todo card one shadow and card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="34" y="222" width="326" height="126" rx="16" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="32" y="220" width="326" height="126" rx="16" fill="#F95A2C" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="52" y="242" width="25" height="25" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="58,254 63,259 72,248" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="92" y="250" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Plan summer campaign</text>
    <text x="92" y="273" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#18191F">Review ideas with the creative team</text>
    <line x1="52" y1="294" x2="338" y2="294" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.45"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="320" r="7" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="78" y="325" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Today · 2:00 PM</text>
    <rect x="274" y="309" width="57" height="23" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
    <text x="302" y="325" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">WORK</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Todo card two shadow and card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="34" y="362" width="326" height="126" rx="16" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="32" y="360" width="326" height="126" rx="16" fill="#00C6AE" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="52" y="382" width="25" height="25" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="92" y="390" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Dentist appointment</text>
    <text x="92" y="413" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#18191F">Bring insurance card and arrive early</text>
    <line x1="52" y1="434" x2="338" y2="434" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.45"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="460" r="7" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="78" y="465" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Thu, Jul 30 · 9:30 AM</text>
    <rect x="281" y="449" width="50" height="23" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8"/>
    <text x="306" y="465" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">LIFE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Today's list -->
  <g>
    <text x="32" y="529" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Today</text>
    <rect x="302" y="510" width="56" height="24" rx="12" fill="#D6FCF7"/>
    <text x="330" y="527" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">3 LEFT</text>

    <rect x="32" y="548" width="326" height="46" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="44" y="559" width="23" height="23" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="80" y="575" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Pick up groceries</text>
    <text x="326" y="575" text-anchor="end" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#969BAB">11:15 AM</text>
    <line x1="32" y1="596" x2="358" y2="596" stroke="#EEEFF4" stroke-width="2"/>

    <rect x="32" y="600" width="326" height="46" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="44" y="611" width="23" height="23" rx="5" fill="#D6FCF7" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="49,622 54,627 63,616" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="80" y="627" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#969BAB">Reply to Jordan's email</text>
    <text x="326" y="627" text-anchor="end" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#969BAB">Done</text>
    <line x1="32" y1="648" x2="358" y2="648" stroke="#EEEFF4" stroke-width="2"/>

    <rect x="32" y="652" width="326" height="46" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="44" y="663" width="23" height="23" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="80" y="679" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Evening walk</text>
    <text x="326" y="679" text-anchor="end" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#969BAB">6:00 PM</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Floating add button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="303" y="684" width="58" height="58" rx="16" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.2"/>
    <rect x="301" y="682" width="58" height="58" rx="16" fill="#1947E5" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="697" x2="330" y2="725" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="316" y1="711" x2="344" y2="711" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="330" y="735" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="1" fill="#FFFFFF">Add</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="754" width="390" height="90" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="754" x2="390" y2="754" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="43,781 54,772 65,781" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="47" y="780" width="14" height="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="54" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Home</text>
    <!-- Tasks active -->
    <rect x="119" y="773" width="24" height="25" rx="5" fill="#D6FCF7" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="124,785 129,790 138,779" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="131" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#1947E5">Tasks</text>
    <!-- Calendar -->
    <rect x="195" y="775" width="25" height="23" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="782" x2="220" y2="782" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="201" y1="771" x2="201" y2="779" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="214" y1="771" x2="214" y2="779" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="207" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Calendar</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="286" cy="779" r="8" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="286" cy="793" rx="14" ry="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="286" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
